question: Which of the following is worshipped by people during the festival of Pongal?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Sun**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Sun** is worshipped by people during the festival of Pongal.
 
• Pongal is a popular harvest festival celebrated in Tamil Nadu, India.
 
• The festival marks the end of the winter solstice and the start of the sun's six-month-long journey northwards (Uttarayana).
 
• It is a four-day festival that includes Bhogi Pongal, Surya Pongal, Mattu Pongal, and Kaanum Pongal.
 
• Surya Pongal, the second day of the festival, is dedicated to the Sun God (Surya) and is the most important day of the festival.
 
• During Surya Pongal, people prepare a special dish called 'Pongal' and offer it to the Sun God as a token of gratitude for a bountiful harvest.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pongal** is celebrated in the month of **Thai** (January-February) according to the Tamil calendar.
 
• The word "Pongal" means "to boil" and refers to the traditional dish prepared from the new harvest of rice boiled in milk with jaggery.
 
• The festival is similar to other harvest festivals celebrated in different parts of India, such as Makar Sankranti in North India, Lohri in Punjab, and Bihu in Assam.
 
• It is a time of joy, family reunions, and thanksgiving for the agricultural abundance.
 
• Pongal is also celebrated with traditional music, dance, and cultural performances.
